# Hoag Land Services

> Professional land clearing, tree services, and fencing for residential and commercial properties in Central Florida. ISA Certified Arborist (FL-9491A). Licensed and Insured. Serving 9 counties from DeLeon Springs, FL since 2017.

Hoag Land Services (HLS) is a Central Florida land services company owned and operated by Tyler Hoag, an ISA Certified Arborist and TRAQ Qualified professional. The company provides three core service categories across 123 locations in Volusia, Flagler, Seminole, Orange, Lake, Putnam, St. Johns, Marion, and Brevard counties.

- Phone: (386) 561-0003
- Email: tyler@hlsdeland.com
- Location: DeLeon Springs, FL 32130
- Google Reviews: 5.0 stars, 40 reviews
- Established: 2017

## Services

- [Tree Services](https://www.hlsdeland.com/services/tree-services): Tree removal, tree trimming, palm pruning, tree installation, stump grinding, and emergency storm cleanup by ISA Certified Arborist
- [Site Work / Land Clearing](https://www.hlsdeland.com/services/site-work): Land clearing, earthworks and excavation, grading, erosion control, environmental services, forestry mulching, driveways, and drainage
- [Fencing Services](https://www.hlsdeland.com/services/fencing): Wood fencing, vinyl fencing, aluminum fencing, farm and ranch fencing for residential and commercial properties

## Agent Interfaces

Machine-readable surfaces on this origin. All are public, read-only, and require
no authentication or registration. See https://www.hlsdeland.com/auth.md

- [Markdown for any page](https://www.hlsdeland.com/): Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page URL and it returns markdown instead of HTML. Response carries `x-markdown-tokens` so you can budget before reading.
- [MCP server](https://www.hlsdeland.com/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP transport. Tools for services, service-area lookup by city or ZIP, contact details, reviews, and page markdown.
- [MCP server card](https://www.hlsdeland.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Server metadata and tool list.
- [Public read API](https://www.hlsdeland.com/api/v1/services): JSON endpoints under `/api/v1` — company, services, service-areas, reviews, health.
- [OpenAPI description](https://www.hlsdeland.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for the read API.
- [API catalog](https://www.hlsdeland.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset.
- [Agent skills](https://www.hlsdeland.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): How to request an estimate, match a job to a service line, check coverage, and handle storm damage.
- [Capability manifest](https://www.hlsdeland.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD manifest of everything above.

Note for agents: do not POST to `/api/contact`, `/api/join` or `/api/approve`.
They are internal handlers for the on-page forms, they email a real person, and
they reject automated submissions. Hand people the form at
https://www.hlsdeland.com/contact or the phone number (386) 561-0003 instead.
